title: Easter egg decor with LED light and remote
text: Easter egg decor with LED light and remote. First, they come with a HORRID bunch of UGLY styro foam balls attached to the bough. (Please see photos provided) SUPER UGLY and they don't look like they even go with the rest of the bough.  So, after I cut the ugly styro foam balls off, it looks better.  I added batteries into the main box (comes with a USB cord if you use rechargeable batteries), pulled the battery plug strip out of the remote and NOTHING.  I pressed the power button on the battery box, lights come on.  To switch the lights to solid on, flashing, etc, etc - just keep pressing the power button on the battery box.  I then turned to the remote control that also offers brightness control and hours on/off, etc... I pulled the battery out and put a new one in - remote worked.  So, it was sent with a dead battery in the remote.  That's a real star deduction.  So, I did get it all working, but it's pretty cheap looking.  I will not be using it as I had thought I would because it does look so cheap.  I think it's pretty much a tosser - but if you are determined, make sure you have spare coin batteries.

product_metadata.title: Impress Life Decorative String Lights Branch Fairy Lights with Robin Blue Eggs, Flowers, Leaves, Remote Control 10FT 30 LED Battery Powered/USB Plug in for Easter Home Decor, Birthday Party, Weddings
features: [Fashionable Design]---The fairy lights with Easter Egg and Garland will make your family a better atmosphere. Easter eggs, also called Paschal eggs, are decorative. They are usually used as gifts on the occasion of Easter. As such, Easter eggs are common during the season of Eastertide. The oldest tradition is to use dyed and painted chicken eggs, but modern custom is chocolate eggs wrapped in colored foil, hand-carved wooden eggs, or plastic eggs filled with confectionery such as chocolate.
[Multifunctional Lighting Modes] --- You can have a better using experience. There are 8 modes for you to choose, such as Timer Flicker, Timer Chasing, Timer Fade, Timer Flash, and the like.
[Supper Bright] --- The string lights are 10Ft with 30 LED, which shine with warm white light. They will be extremly amazing for your room decoration.
[Easy to Use] --- You just need to put the 3AA batteries into the box and push the Button on the battery box or touch the Remote; then the lighs will be lighting.
[Safe Usage] --- You will have no worries about the danger of Heating and Burning. Besides, you can return the item if you don't like it once received.
